name: forgehub-app
description: Desktop app for ComfyUI workflows on Runpod Serverless
author: huchukato

scripts.backend:bundle: cd .. && uv run --with pyinstaller pyinstaller packaging/backend_entry.py --name forgehub-backend --onefile --noconfirm --distpath backend-dist --workpath backend-build --paths . --collect-submodules uvicorn --collect-data certifi --collect-binaries imageio_ffmpeg
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run icon && npm run backend:bundle && electron-builder
